method: Each ZIP imported into a dedicated PEBREL_CONFIG_DIR. Each theme loaded in a separate real Pebrel process; terminal content sent with the Runtime API. Native window resized to 1600x1000 physical pixels and the DWM visible bounds captured from the desktop. No screenshot retouching or simulated UI. QA windows closed through the Runtime API. This is a per-theme render test, not a hot-switch API test.
demo: Dedicated PowerShell output, not real project/build results. Chinese, English, ANSI 16 colors, comments, code, status labels and sidebar selection.
font: Maple Mono Normal NF CN, logical font_size=13; font setting belongs to QA profile, not forced by theme.
limitations: Visual review at one Windows DPI/window size; no claim of accessibility conformance for every background pixel.
Mica/Acrylic are Windows window materials, not an assertion that background-image pixels are blurred.
macOS/Linux and public release downloads not tested.
